title: Validation of an automated quantitative imaging measurement
purpose: Assess whether measurement validity, performance, agreement, uncertainty and multicenter imaging effects are separated without selecting a method or treating the expert reference as infallible.
initialUserIntent: We have developed an automated quantitative measurement of myocardial fibrosis from late-gadolinium-enhancement cardiac MRI. We want to validate it across several centers against expert manual assessment, but we have not yet decided the exact validation framework or primary performance endpoint.

knownFacts.statement: An automated quantitative measurement of myocardial fibrosis has been developed.
The measurement uses late-gadolinium-enhancement cardiac MRI.
Validation across several centers is intended.
Expert manual assessment is the intended comparator.

unresolvedDecisions.statement: Scientific construct and exact observable property represented by the automated measurement.
Exact measurement definition, unit and operational validity conditions.
Reference/comparator strategy and handling of expert-reference variability.
Validation framework and primary performance endpoint.
Relevant agreement, precision, repeatability, reproducibility and uncertainty dimensions.
Scanner, site, acquisition, software and reader harmonization strategy.
Analysis population, sampling and statistical analysis strategy.

outOfScopeInformation: No threshold, segmentation convention or unit definition is supplied.
No exact scanner, acquisition, software or reconstruction distribution is supplied.
No reader count, adjudication process or manual-reference reliability estimate is supplied.
No effect size, expected error distribution or sample-size input is supplied.
allowedClarifications: Clarify the intended construct, observable property and operational measurement definition.
Clarify the purpose of validation and which performance dimension could support the principal decision.
Clarify how the expert comparator is produced, repeated and adjudicated.
Clarify site, scanner, acquisition, software and patient-spectrum heterogeneity.
Clarify clinically or scientifically meaningful error and uncertainty tolerances.

conditionalOwners.condition: When the adopted measurement workflow creates material acquisition, transfer, derivation, QC or audit-trail requirements.
Only if later Project facts make a regulated-purpose qualification materially relevant.

terminalTarget: A coherent versioned measurement-validation Research Project preserving reference and performance uncertainties, with current Protocol/TMP/DOC projection reachable after the necessary human adoptions.
